📌 How This Works

  • Questions 1–40 (multiple choice): pick an answer – the correct answer and a full explanation (including why the other choices are wrong) appear immediately.
  • Questions 41–44 (free response): optionally type your answer in the scratch box, then click “Show answer & explanation” for each part to self-check.
  • The A–D buttons beside each choice cross out an answer; Mark for Review flags a question; click “Question x of 44” to open the navigator.
  • Use the ← / → keys to move between questions. The score counts multiple choice only.
